body.zh-CN: 研究人、Agent 与执行环境在信息、权限和操作能力不对称时的科研协作。网站是只读证据浏览器，不执行模型、实验或裁判。
body.en: The benchmark studies scientific collaboration when humans, agents and execution environments differ in information, permissions and capabilities. This website is a read-only evidence browser, not an execution or judging service.

body.zh-CN: 24 个设计模板覆盖身份、质量控制、多组学、统计、异步协作和治理。H0/H1 是指定正常与善意失误条件。模板、实例、重复和运行尝试分别记录。
body.en: 24 design templates cover identity, quality control, multiomics, statistics, asynchronous work and governance. H0/H1 denote specified normal and unintentional-error conditions. Templates, instances, repetitions and attempts are distinct.

body.zh-CN: 交互式模拟、确定性回放与真人研究分区呈现。浏览轨迹不改变实验模式。逻辑 tick 不是实际耗时；累计调用时间不能当作 episode 墙钟。
body.en: Interactive simulation, deterministic replay and human studies are separate modes. Browsing a trace does not change its experimental mode. Logical ticks are not elapsed time; cumulative call time is not episode wall-clock duration.

body.zh-CN: 技术轨迹、严格完成、科学有效性、授权合规、H/A 协议问题独立展示。未评不填零。没有冻结统计包时，不在前端计算成功率、置信区间、因果效应或名次。
body.en: Technical trajectory, strict completion, scientific validity, authorization and H/A protocol issues are separate outcomes. Not assessed is not zero. Without a frozen statistical release, the frontend computes no success rates, confidence intervals, causal effects or ranks.

body.zh-CN: 作者自验、独立工程核验、科学方法审阅及公开批准不是同一种审查。本演示数据与英文工程译稿均不具备真实科学审阅身份。真实数据仅允许通过审核的白名单发布包进入网站。
body.en: Author checks, independent engineering verification, scientific-method review and release approval are distinct. This demo and its engineering translations have no real scientific review status. Real data must enter through a reviewed, allowlisted release.

body.zh-CN: 发布包包含明确契约版本、精确文件清单、SHA-256 和审查身份。任何重跑作为新尝试保留，不能覆盖失败。更正通过新版本与替代/撤回记录表达。
body.en: Releases contain explicit schema versions, exact file inventories, SHA-256 checksums and review provenance. Reruns remain separate attempts and never overwrite failures. Corrections use new releases with replacement or withdrawal records.
